verdict.rationale: Rive's official MCP integration lets AI take over repetitive, high-volume editor tasks such as building State Machines with hundreds of states or layers, so the product itself offers some at-scale operation. Source-component edits also propagate to every instance. Neither is a documented general-purpose bulk operation (select or filter many items and apply one action), and RML-as-code is only a building block. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch-operation documentation, multi-item selection and apply semantics, cross-file batch processing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
Changes made to the source component are reflected across all of its instances.
